articles.title: Zombie Spiders and Rainbow Worms: 10 Creatures Named After David Attenborough
articles.summary: A fungus that turns cave spiders into zombies is one of about 50 living things named after David Attenborough. Scientists grew up watching his shows and now honor him with their discoveries. Here are 10 of the coolest ones.

articles.title: Tiny Particles Light Up Inside Your Body—Using Sound, Not Surgery!
articles.summary: Scientists made nanoparticles that glow when hit by ultrasound. Injected into mice, they lit up deep inside the brain, gut, and spine. This could one day replace invasive surgeries for light-based treatments like cancer therapy.

articles.title: Will AI Steal Your Job? A Nobel Prize Winner Says Not So Fast
articles.summary: Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu thinks AI won't cause a jobs apocalypse. He says AI agents still can't juggle tasks like humans do. But he worries that AI companies hiring economists might twist the truth about jobs.
